BFO_0000015.label: process
BFO_0000015.definition: p is a process = Def. p is an occurrent that has temporal proper parts and for some time t, p s-depends_on some material entity at t. (axiom label in BFO2 Reference: [083-003])

IDO_0000586.label: infection
IDO_0000586.definition: A part of an extended organism that itself has as part a population of one or more infectious agents and that (1) exists as a result of processes initiated by members of the infectious agent population and is (2) clinically abnormal in virtue of the presence of this infectious agent population, or (3) has a disposition to bring clinical abnormality to immunocompetent organisms of the same Species as the host (the organism corresponding to the extended organism) through transmission of a member or offspring of a member of the infectious agent population.

BFO_0000002.label: continuant
BFO_0000002.definition: An entity that exists in full at any time in which it exists at all, persists through time while maintaining its identity and has no temporal parts.

BFO_0000003.label: occurrent
BFO_0000003.definition: An entity that has temporal parts and that happens, unfolds or develops through time.

BFO_0000040.label: material entity
BFO_0000040.definition: An independent continuant that is spatially extended whose identity is independent of that of other entities and can be maintained through time.

IDO_0000597.label: host exposure to environment containing infectious agent
IDO_0000597.definition: A process in which a potential host of an infectious agent is exposed to an environment in which the infectious agent is present and physical contact between the two can occur, but such contact is not planned.

BFO_0000020.label: specifically dependent continuant
BFO_0000020.definition: b is a specifically dependent continuant = Def. b is a continuant & there is some independent continuant c which is not a spatial region and which is such that b s-depends_on c at every time t during the course of b’s existence. (axiom label in BFO2 Reference: [050-003])

IDO_0000658.label: host exposure to infectious agent
IDO_0000658.definition: A process in which a potential host of an infectious agent is exposed to an infectious agent.

BFO_0000023.label: role
BFO_0000023.definition: A realizable entity  the manifestation of which brings about some result or end that is not essential to a continuant  in virtue of the kind of thing that it is but that can be served or participated in by that kind of continuant  in some kinds of natural, social or institutional contexts.

IDO_0000531.label: host
IDO_0000531.definition: An organism bearing a host role.

GO_0008150.label: biological_process
GO_0008150.definition: Any process specifically pertinent to the functioning of integrated living units: cells, tissues, organs, and organisms. A process is a collection of molecular events with a defined beginning and end.

OBI_0100026.label: organism
OBI_0100026.definition: A material entity that is an individual living system, such as animal, plant, bacteria or virus, that is capable of replicating or reproducing, growth and maintenance in the right environment. An organism may be unicellular or made up, like humans, of many billions of cells divided into specialized tissues and organs.

BFO_0000004.label: independent continuant
BFO_0000004.definition: b is an independent continuant = Def. b is a continuant which is such that there is no c and no t such that b s-depends_on c at t. (axiom label in BFO2 Reference: [017-002])

TRANS_0000000.label: transmission process
TRANS_0000000.definition: A process that is the means during which the pathogen is transmitted directly or indirectly from its natural reservoir, a susceptible host or source to a new host.

BFO_0000017.label: realizable entity
BFO_0000017.definition: A specifically dependent continuant  that inheres in continuant  entities and are not exhibited in full at every time in which it inheres in an entity or group of entities. The exhibition or actualization of a realizable entity is a particular manifestation, functioning or process that occurs under certain circumstances.

IDO_0000495.label: infectious disease course
IDO_0000495.definition: A disease course that is the realization of an infectious disease.

IDO_0000408.label: symbiont host role
IDO_0000408.definition: A host role borne by an organism in virtue of the fact that its extended organism contains a second organism and provides an environment supportive for the survival, growth, maturation, or reproduction of that organism.

IDO_0000596.label: infectious agent
IDO_0000596.definition: An organism that has an infectious disposition.

IDO_0000483.label: infectious disease incidence rate
IDO_0000483.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the infectious disease incidence proportion per unit time.

IDO_0000485.label: infectious disease prevalence
IDO_0000485.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the number of realizations of an infectious disease in the population at a specified time.

IDO_0000490.label: infectious disease endemicity
IDO_0000490.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population in virtue of the fact that infections of the type that causes an infectious disease are maintained in the population via intra-population transmission or by transmission from a local reservoir.

IDO_0000610.label: immunosuppression
IDO_0000610.definition: A process that attenuates an immune response.

OGMS_0000063.label: disease course
OGMS_0000063.definition: The totality of all processes through which a given disease instance is realized.

IDO_0000629.label: host role
IDO_0000629.definition: A role borne by an organism in virtue of the fact that it's extended organism contains a material entity other than the organism.

IDO_0000502.label: infectious disease epidemic
IDO_0000502.definition: A process of infectious disease realizations and for which there is a statistically significant increase in the infectious disease incidence of a population.

IDO_0000503.label: infectious disease pandemic
IDO_0000503.definition: A process in which multiple infectious disease epidemics of the same type of infectious disease unfold over overlapping periods of time and affect organism populations located in different geographic regions, including different countries and continents.

IDO_0000603.label: process of establishing an infection
IDO_0000603.definition: A process by which an infectious agent, established in a host, becomes part of an infection in the host.

IDO_0000504.label: infectious disorder
IDO_0000504.definition: An infection that is clinically abnormal.

GO_0044409.label: entry into host
GO_0044409.definition: Penetration by an organism into the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.

GO_0051234.label: establishment of localization
GO_0051234.definition: Any process that localizes a substance or cellular component. This may occur via movement, tethering or selective degradation.

GO_0051704.label: multi-organism process
GO_0051704.definition: A biological process which involves another organism of the same or different species.

IDO_0000475.label: local infection
IDO_0000475.definition: An infection for which the infectious agents that are part of the infection are limited to a relatively small area of the host's body.

IDO_0000590.label: chronic infectious disease course
IDO_0000590.definition: An infectious disease course that unfolds over a long period of time.

IDO_0000612.label: pathologic immunosuppression
IDO_0000612.definition: An immunosuppression process which arises as the result of a disorder.

IDO_0000625.label: establishment of localization in host
IDO_0000625.definition: An establishment of localization process in which a material entity reaches a site in an organism in which it can survive, grow, multiply, or mature.

OGMS_0000045.label: disorder
OGMS_0000045.definition: A material entity which is clinically abnormal and part of an extended organism. Disorders are the physical basis of disease.

GO_0044406.label: adhesion of symbiont to host
GO_0044406.definition: The attachment of a symbiont to its host via adhesion molecules, general stickiness etc., either directly or indirectly. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.

IDO_0000479.label: infectious disease incidence
IDO_0000479.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the number of realizations of an infectious disease for which the infectious disease course begins during a specified period of time.

IDO_0000480.label: infection incidence
IDO_0000480.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the number of organisms in the population that become infected with an infectious agent during a specified period of time.

IDO_0000481.label: infectious disease incidence proportion
IDO_0000481.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the proportion of members of the population not experiencing an infectious disease course at the beginning of a specified period of time and in whom the infectious disease begins during the specified period of time.

IDO_0000482.label: infection incidence proportion
IDO_0000482.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the proportion of members of the population not infected at the beginning of a specified period of time who become infected during the specified period of time.

IDO_0000484.label: infection incidence rate
IDO_0000484.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the infection incidence proportion per unit time.

IDO_0000486.label: infection prevalence
IDO_0000486.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the number of organisms in the population infected with an infectious agent at a specified time.

IDO_0000487.label: infectious disease lifetime prevalence
IDO_0000487.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the number of organisms in the population who have, at any point during their lives, been bearers of an infectious disease and experienced realization of the disease.

IDO_0000489.label: infectious disease mortality rate
IDO_0000489.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population and is the per capita number of deaths in the population resulting from an infectious disease over a specified period of time.

IDO_0000494.label: infectious disease sporadicity
IDO_0000494.definition: A quality that inheres in an organism population by virtue of the fact that realizations of an infectious disease occur in the population with a fluctuating prevalence.

IDO_0000528.label: pathogen
IDO_0000528.definition: A material entity with a pathogenic disposition.

IDO_0000545.label: infectious agent reservoir
IDO_0000545.definition: A material entity bearing an infectious agent reservoir role.

IDO_0000593.label: transmission period
IDO_0000593.definition: A continuous temporal interval during which a transmission process occurs.

IDO_0000594.label: direct host exposure to infectious agent
IDO_0000594.definition: A process in which a potential host of an infectious agent comes into direct physical contact with the infectious agent.

IDO_0000656.label: horizontal pathogen transmission process
IDO_0000656.definition: A pathogen transmission process in which a pathogen is transmitted from one host to another of the same Species, and the two hosts are not in a parent-child relationship.

IDO_0000665.label: source of infection
IDO_0000665.definition: A material entity bearing a source of infection role.

IDO_0000415.label: pathogen host role
IDO_0000415.definition: A host role borne by an organism in virtue of the fact that its extended organism contains a pathogen.

IDO_0000456.label: immunosuppressed organism
IDO_0000456.definition: An organism that is experiencing pregnancy-induced or pathologic immunosuppression.

IDO_0000538.label: pathogen host
IDO_0000538.definition: An organism bearing a pathogen host role.

OGMS_0000031.label: disease
OGMS_0000031.definition: A disposition (i) to undergo pathological processes that (ii) exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

IDO_0000537.label: infectious agent host
IDO_0000537.definition: An organism bearing an infectious agent host role.

IDO_0000405.label: pathogen role
IDO_0000405.definition: A role borne by pathogen in virtue of the fact that it or one of its products is sufficiently close to an organism towards which it has the pathogenic disposition to allow realization of the pathogenic disposition.

IDO_0000424.label: reservoir of infectious agent role
IDO_0000424.definition: A role borne by a material entity in virtue of the fact that it is a habitat in which infectious agents can persist and multiply and from which they can be transmitted in virtue of prevailing practices of potential hosts.

IDO_0000434.label: primary infection role
IDO_0000434.definition: A role borne by an infectious disorder in virtue of the fact that (1) the host has at least two distinct infectious disorders, where neither arose from the other through metastasis, (2) at the time the infectious disorder was established in the host, the host had no infectious disorder, and (3) the infectious disorder increases the host's susceptibility to infectious disorders.

IDO_0000435.label: secondary infection role
IDO_0000435.definition: A role borne by an infectious disorder in virtue of the fact that (1) the host has at least two distinct infectious disorders, where neither arose from the other through metastasis, (2) at the time the infectious disorder was established in the host, the host had a primary infectious disorder, and (3) establishment of the infectious disorder occurs because of increased susceptibility to infectious disorders conferred by the primary infectious disorder.

IDO_0000459.label: colonized host
IDO_0000459.definition: An organism that contains a colony in or on its extended organism.

IDO_0000471.label: complex infection
IDO_0000471.definition: An infection comprised of infectious organisms from different Species.

IDO_0000472.label: extracellular infection
IDO_0000472.definition: An infection for which the infectious agents that are part of the infection persist in the extracellular space of the host.

IDO_0000473.label: intracellular infection
IDO_0000473.definition: An infection for which the infectious agents that are part of the infection persist inside host cells.

IDO_0000474.label: systemic infection
IDO_0000474.definition: An infection for which the infectious agents that are part of the infection are distributed throughout the host.

IDO_0000477.label: acute infectious disease course
IDO_0000477.definition: An infectious disease course that begins soon after infection is established and progresses rapidly to severe stages.

IDO_0000491.label: infectious disease endemic level
IDO_0000491.definition: An infectious disease prevalence that is typical for an infectious disease in an organism population.

IDO_0000492.label: infectious disease endemic rate
IDO_0000492.definition: An infectious disease incidence rate that is typical for an infectious disease in an organism population.

IDO_0000493.label: infectious disease hyper-endemicity
IDO_0000493.definition: An infectious disease endemicity that inheres in an organism population in virtue of the fact that the infectious disease endemic level for an infectious disease is persistently high in the population.

IDO_0000570.label: subclinical infection
IDO_0000570.definition: An infection that is part of an asymptomatic host.

IDO_0000595.label: potential host of infectious agent
IDO_0000595.definition: An organism that has the capability to bear a host of infectious agent role.

IDO_0000598.label: host living with infected household contact
IDO_0000598.definition: A host exposure to environment with infectious agent where the environment is a household that also has an infected host

IDO_0000599.label: host living in endemic area
IDO_0000599.definition: A host exposure to environment with infectious agent where the environment is an area in which an infectious agent is endemic

IDO_0000600.label: release of infectious human pathogen in laboratory
IDO_0000600.definition: A host exposure to environment with infectious agent where the exposure is accidental; the environment is a laboratory, and the infectious agent is infectious in humans.

IDO_0000601.label: host coming into contact with vector of infectious agent
IDO_0000601.definition: A host exposure to environment with infectious agent where the environment contains an infectious agent vector.

IDO_0000602.label: host exposure to substance that might have infectious agent
IDO_0000602.definition: A host exposure to environment with infectious agent where the environment contains a material entity that has been assessed to confer a risk of infection.

IDO_0000628.label: chronic infection
IDO_0000628.definition: An infection that persists for an extended period of time.

IDO_0000630.label: hospital-acquired infection
IDO_0000630.definition: An infection resulting from a transmission process that unfolds in a hospital.

IDO_0000631.label: community-acquired infection
IDO_0000631.definition: An infection resulting from a transmission process that did not unfold in a health care facility.

IDO_0000633.label: metatstatic infection
IDO_0000633.definition: An infection established as a result of spread from another infection in a non-adjacent location in the extended organism of the host.

IDO_0000635.label: source of infection role
IDO_0000635.definition: A role borne by a material entity in virtue of the fact that it contains a site from which an infectious agent is transmitted.

IDO_0000638.label: nursing-home acquired infection
IDO_0000638.definition: An infection resulting from a transmission process that unfolds in a nursing home.

IDO_0000642.label: simple infection
IDO_0000642.definition: An infection comprised of infectious organisms all of the same Species.

IDO_0001003.label: infection-based immunosuppression
IDO_0001003.definition: A pathologic immunosuppression process which arises as the result of an infection and is initiated or dysregulated by the infectious agent population.

IDO_0001005.label: pathologically immunosuppressed organism
IDO_0001005.definition: An immunosuppressed organism that is experiencing pathologic immunosuppression.

GO_0044411.label: entry into host through host barriers
GO_0044411.definition: Penetration by an organism into its host organism via active breaching of the physical barriers of the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.

IDO_0000436.label: infectious disease
IDO_0000436.definition: A disease whose physical basis is an infectious disorder.

IDO_0000476.label: focal infection
IDO_0000476.definition: A local infection for which symptoms are observed in parts of the host's extended organism that are distant from the infection.

IDO_0000496.label: long-term non-progressing infectious disease course
IDO_0000496.definition: A chronic infectious disease course that does not progress to severe stages for a long period of time.

IDO_0000530.label: primary pathogen
IDO_0000530.definition: An infectious agent with a primary infectious disposition.

IDO_0000532.label: definitive host
IDO_0000532.definition: An organism bearing a definitive host role.

IDO_0000533.label: intermediate host
IDO_0000533.definition: A organism bearing an intermediate host role.

IDO_0000534.label: paratenic host
IDO_0000534.definition: An organism bearing a paratenic host role.

IDO_0000535.label: dead-end host
IDO_0000535.definition: An organism bearing a dead-end host role.

PHIPO:0000001.label: pathogen host interaction phenotype
PHIPO:0000001.definition: Any of the set of observable characteristics arising from the interaction of a potentially pathogenic organism with a host organism.

PHIPO:0000160.label: pathogen penetration across barrier phenotype
PHIPO:0000160.definition: A single species phenotype which affects the pathogen's ability to penetrate a given experimental substance/membrane in an in vitro assay.

PHIPO:0000510.label: pathogen host interaction cell phenotype
PHIPO:0000510.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype that is observed at the level of an individual cell.

PHIPO:0001196.label: host defense-induced substance level phenotype
PHIPO:0001196.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, which affects the level of a host produced substance during infection.
synonyms: pathogen induced host substance level phenotype

PHIPO:0000332.label: pathogen colonization of host phenotype
PHIPO:0000332.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype which affects the pathogen colonization of the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism.

PHIPO:0000347.label: pathogen host interaction molecular function phenotype
PHIPO:0000347.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype that affects a molecular function such as binding or catalytic activity.

PHIPO:0000505.label: phenotype
PHIPO:0000505.definition: Any of the set of observable characteristics of an organism resulting from the interaction of its genotype with the environment.

PHIPO:0000032.label: abnormal formation of pathogen penetration structure
PHIPO:0000032.definition: A single species pathogen growth phenotype in which the formation of the pathogen penetration structure is abnormal (i.e different than wild-type) when assessed for penetration ability on a given experimental substance/membrane.
synonyms: abnormal formation of pathogen infection structure

PHIPO:0001197.label: level of pathogen produced substance within host phenotype
PHIPO:0001197.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, which affects the level of a pathogen produced substance during host infection.

PHIPO:0000002.label: single species phenotype
PHIPO:0000002.definition: Any of the set of observable characteristics of a single organism resulting from the interaction of its genotype with the environment.

PHIPO:0001247.label: pathogen modulation of host metabolic process phenotype
PHIPO:0001247.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, in which a pathogen effects a change in the metabolic processes of its host organism.

PHIPO:0000031.label: abnormal pathogen growth after penetration of the barrier
PHIPO:0000031.definition: A single species phenotype in which the pathogen's ability to contine to grow after penetration of a given experimental substance/membrane in an in vitro assay is abnormal (i.e indistinguishable from wild type).

PHIPO:0001006.label: abnormal host morphology during pathogen invasion
PHIPO:0001006.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype where the morphology of the host during pathogen invasion is abnormal. This relates to the pathogen colonization of the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism.

CHEBI:50906.label: role
CHEBI:50906.definition: A role is particular behaviour which a material entity may exhibit.

PHIPO:0000024.label: pathogen penetration across the barrier present
PHIPO:0000024.definition: A single species pathogen penetration phenotype in which pathogen penetration of a given experimental substance/membrane is present.

PHIPO:0000164.label: pathogen host interaction binding phenotype
PHIPO:0000164.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype that affects the binding of a gene product to another substance. The affected gene product may be encoded by the mutated gene, or by a different gene.

PHIPO:0000480.label: presence of pathogen-associated host lesions
PHIPO:0000480.definition: A phenotype where the process of host tissue cell death causing a host lesion is present.
synonyms: normal host lesion formation with pathogen
presence of host necrotic cell death by pathogen

PHIPO:0000949.label: pathogen entry into host phenotype
PHIPO:0000949.definition: A pathogen colonization of host phenotype which affects the penetration of the pathogen into the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism (GO:0044409).

PHIPO:0001108.label: pathogen host interaction pH phenotype
PHIPO:0001108.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype that affects the pH in a pathogen or host cell or cellular component.

BFO:0000002.label: continuant
BFO:0000002.definition: An entity that exists in full at any time in which it exists at all, persists through time while maintaining its identity and has no temporal parts.

PHIPO:0000200.label: host chlorosis phenotype in presence of pathogen
PHIPO:0000200.definition: A pathogen-host interaction phenotype in which leaves produce insufficient chlorophyll.

PHIPO:0000439.label: pathogen reproductive phenotype within host
PHIPO:0000439.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype which affects the pathogen reproductive process within the host. The production of new individuals that contain some portion of genetic material inherited from one or more parent organisms (GO:0000003).

PHIPO:0000445.label: pathogen host interaction host lesion formation phenotype
PHIPO:0000445.definition: A phenotype that affects the process of host tissue death causing a host lesion induced by either the pathogen directly killing host tissue (e.g. cell wall degradation), or the host activating its own cell death pathways in defense.
synonyms: host necrotic lesion with pathogen phenotype

PHIPO:0000998.label: pathogen morphology phenotype during colonization of host
PHIPO:0000998.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype which affects the pathogen morphology during host colonization. This relates to the pathogen colonization of the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism.

PHIPO:0001002.label: host morphology phenotype during pathogen invasion
PHIPO:0001002.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype which affects the host morphology during pathogen invasion. This relates to the pathogen colonization of the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism

PHIPO:0001070.label: host organism viability with pathogen phenotype
PHIPO:0001070.definition: A pathogen host interaction organism level phenotype which affects the viability of an individual host organism in the presence of a pathogen.

PHIPO:0001080.label: altered pathogen pigment accumulation within host
PHIPO:0001080.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, in which the accumulation of pathogen pigmentation (coloring matter) usually present during infection differs from normal.

PHIPO:0000369.label: abnormal formation of pathogen penetration structure when near host
PHIPO:0000369.definition: A pathogen growth with host phenotype in which the formation of the pathogen penetration structure is abnormal (i.e different than wild-type).
synonyms: abnormal formation of pathogen infection structure when near host

PHIPO:0001167.label: pathogen modulation of host immune system process phenotype
PHIPO:0001167.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype that affects a host immune system process during pathogen infection (GO:0002376).

PHIPO:0000011.label: virulence phenotype
PHIPO:0000011.definition: A phenotype that is relevant to virulence. Virulence is the degree to which a pathogen (species or strain) is able to cause infectious disease in another organism. (Virulence is observed where pathogenicity is present).

PHIPO:0000236.label: pathogen host interaction localization phenotype
PHIPO:0000236.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype that affects the localization of a structure or substance in a cell.

PHIPO:0000999.label: abnormal pathogen morphology during colonization of host
PHIPO:0000999.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype where the morphology of the pathogen during host colonization is abnormal. This relates to the pathogen colonization of the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism.

PHIPO:0001159.label: pathogen tissue to tissue migration within host phenotype
PHIPO:0001159.definition: A pathogen host interaction colonization phenotype which affects the directional tissue to tissue movement of the pathogen within the host organism (GO:0044001).

PHIPO:0001173.label: pathogen modulation of host process phenotype
PHIPO:0001173.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, in which a pathogen effects a change in the structure or processes of its host organism (GO:0044003).

GO:0008150.label: biological_process
GO:0008150.definition: A biological process is the execution of a genetically-encoded biological module or program. It consists of all the steps required to achieve the specific biological objective of the module. A biological process is accomplished by a particular set of molecular functions carried out by specific gene products (or macromolecular complexes), often in a highly regulated manner and in a particular temporal sequence.

PHIPO:0000334.label: abnormal pathogen cell to cell migration within host
PHIPO:0000334.definition: A pathogen host interaction colonization phenotype in which the occurrence of the directional movement of the pathogen within the host organism is abnormal.

PHIPO:0000469.label: abnormal pathogen asexual sporulation within host
PHIPO:0000469.definition: A pathogen reproductive phenotype within host where the process of pathogen asexual sporulation, the formation of spores derived from the products of an asexual cell division, is abnormal (GO:0030436).

BFO:0000003.label: occurrent
BFO:0000003.definition: An entity that has temporal parts and that happens, unfolds or develops through time.

CHEBI:24432.label: biological role
CHEBI:24432.definition: A role played by the molecular entity or part thereof within a biological context.

PHIPO:0001250.label: abnormal host structure induced by pathogen
PHIPO:0001250.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype where the development of a host structure is abnormal during pathogen infection.

PHIPO:0000331.label: pathogen penetration into host present
PHIPO:0000331.definition: A pathogen entry into host phenotype in which pathogen penetration into the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism is present.

PHIPO:0000924.label: host defense-induced oxidative burst level phenotype
PHIPO:0000924.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, which affects a pathogen induced host oxidative burst level (GO:0002679).
synonyms: pathogen host interaction respiratory burst phenotype
pathogen induced host oxidative burst level phenotype
pathogen-induced host oxidative burst level phenotype

PHIPO:0000954.label: presence of pathogen growth within host
PHIPO:0000954.definition: A pathogen host phenotype in which the vegetative growth or proliferation of the pathogen inside the host is present.
synonyms: normal post penetration of host by pathogen

BFO:0000004.label: independent continuant
BFO:0000004.definition: A continuant that is a bearer of quality and realizable entity entities, in which other entities inhere and which itself cannot inhere in anything.

BFO:0000015.label: process
BFO:0000015.definition: An occurrent that has temporal proper parts and for some time t, p s-depends_on some material entity at t.

PHIPO:0000027.label: normal pathogen growth after penetration of the barrier
PHIPO:0000027.definition: A single species phenotype in which the pathogen's ability to contine to grow after penetration of a given experimental substance/membrane in an in vitro assay is normal (i.e indistinguishable from wild type).

PHIPO:0000188.label: pathogen growth on host surface phenotype
PHIPO:0000188.definition: A pathogen colonization of host phenotype which affects the vegetative growth or proliferation of the pathogen on the host surface.

PHIPO:0000333.label: pathogen cell to cell migration within host phenotype
PHIPO:0000333.definition: A pathogen host interaction colonization phenotype which affects the directional movement of the pathogen within the host organism (GO:0044001).

PHIPO:0000411.label: molecular function phenotype
PHIPO:0000411.definition: A phenotype that affects a molecular function such as binding or catalytic activity.

PHIPO:0000440.label: normal pathogen reproductive phenotype within host
PHIPO:0000440.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype where the pathogen reproductive process within the host is normal (indistinguishable from wild type).

PHIPO:0000481.label: absence of pathogen-associated host lesions
PHIPO:0000481.definition: A phenotype where the process of host tissue cell death causing a host lesion is absent.
synonyms: absence of host necrotic cell death by pathogen

PHIPO:0000951.label: pathogen growth within host phenotype
PHIPO:0000951.definition: A pathogen host phenotype which affects the vegetative growth or proliferation of the pathogen inside the host (e.g. after entry by penetration or infiltration).

PHIPO:0001259.label: host cell viability with pathogen phenotype
PHIPO:0001259.definition: A pathogen host interaction cell level phenotype which affects the viability of a host cell in the presence of a pathogen.

PHIPO:0001043.label: level of pathogen produced toxin within host phenotype
PHIPO:0001043.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, which affects the level of pathogen produced toxin during host infection.

PHIPO:0001262.label: host defense-induced protein level phenotype
PHIPO:0001262.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, which affects the level of a host produced protein during infection.

PHIPO:0001263.label: host defense-induced RNA level phenotype
PHIPO:0001263.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, which affects the level of a host produced RNA during infection.

PHIPO:0001267.label: level of pathogen produced RNA within host phenotype
PHIPO:0001267.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, which affects the level of pathogen produced RNA during host infection.

BFO:0000020.label: specifically dependent continuant
BFO:0000020.definition: A continuant that inheres in or is borne by other entities. Every instance of A requires some specific instance of B which must always be the same.

CHEBI:64909.label: poison
CHEBI:64909.definition: Any substance that causes disturbance to organisms by chemical reaction or other activity on the molecular scale, when a sufficient quantity is absorbed by the organism.

PHIPO:0000028.label: normal formation of pathogen penetration structure
PHIPO:0000028.definition: A single species pathogen growth phenotype in which the formation of the pathogen penetration structure is normal (i.e same as wild-type) when assessed for penetration ability on a given experimental substance/membrane.
synonyms: normal formation of pathogen infection structure

PHIPO:0000030.label: pathogen penetration across the barrier absent
PHIPO:0000030.definition: A single species pathogen penetration phenotype in which pathogen penetration of a given experimental substance/membrane is absent.

PHIPO:0000402.label: individual organism phenotype
PHIPO:0000402.definition: A single species phenotype that is observed at the level of an individual organism.

PHIPO:0000441.label: abnormal pathogen reproductive phenotype within host
PHIPO:0000441.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype where the pathogen reproductive process within the host is abnormal.

PHIPO:0001005.label: normal host morphology during pathogen invasion
PHIPO:0001005.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype where the morphology of the host during pathogen invasion is normal (indistinguishable from wild type). This relates to the pathogen colonization of the body, tissues, or cells of the host organism.

PHIPO:0001165.label: abnormal host seed development induced by pathogen
PHIPO:0001165.definition: A host reproductive phenotype with pathogen where the process of host seed development is abnormal (GO:0048316).
synonyms: abnormal host grain development with pathogen

PHIPO:0001179.label: infective ability phenotype
PHIPO:0001179.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype that affects the infective ability of a pathogen during attempted colonization of a host.

PATO:0000001.label: quality
PATO:0000001.definition: A dependent entity that inheres in a bearer by virtue of how the bearer is related to other entities

PHIPO:0000034.label: cell phenotype
PHIPO:0000034.definition: A single species phenotype that is observed at the level of an individual cell.

PHIPO:0000131.label: pathogen host protein-protein interaction phenotype
PHIPO:0000131.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype which affects the binding of one pathogen protein to one host protein. The relevant proteins may include the one encoded by the mutated gene, or may both be encoded by different genes.

PHIPO:0000985.label: decreased extent of pathogen-associated host lesions
PHIPO:0000985.definition: A phenotype where the process of host tissue cell death causing a host lesion occurs to a lesser extent than normal.
synonyms: decreased number of pathogen-associated host lesions
decreased size of pathogen-associated host lesion

PHIPO:0001175.label: normal pathogen protein localization within host
PHIPO:0001175.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, in which the localization of a pathogen protein in a host cell is normal.

PHIPO:0001268.label: presence of host gall during pathogen invasion
PHIPO:0001268.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype where the presence of a pathogen (or symbiont) has resulted in the abnormal growth of the host tissue, forming a plant gall (BTO:0005833 plant gall).

GO:0032502.label: developmental process
GO:0032502.definition: A biological process whose specific outcome is the progression of an integrated living unit: an anatomical structure (which may be a subcellular structure, cell, tissue, or organ), or organism over time from an initial condition to a later condition.

BFO:0000040.label: material entity
BFO:0000040.definition: An independent continuant that is spatially extended whose identity is independent of that of other entities and can be maintained through time.

CHEBI:27026.label: toxin
CHEBI:27026.definition: Poisonous substance produced by a biological organism such as a microbe, animal or plant.

GO:0003674.label: molecular_function
GO:0003674.definition: A molecular process that can be carried out by the action of a single macromolecular machine, usually via direct physical interactions with other molecular entities. Function in this sense denotes an action, or activity, that a gene product (or a complex) performs.

PHIPO:0000015.label: reduced virulence
PHIPO:0000015.definition: A phenotype where the degree to which a pathogen (species or strain) is able to cause infectious disease in another organism is decreased (i.e. fewer symptoms than normal).

PHIPO:0000158.label: binding phenotype
PHIPO:0000158.definition: A single species phenotype that affects the binding of a gene product to another substance. The affected gene product may be encoded by the mutated gene, or by a different gene.

PHIPO:0000240.label: abnormal pathogen protein localization within host
PHIPO:0000240.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, in which the localization of a pathogen protein in a host cell differs from normal.

PHIPO:0000349.label: presence of pathogen growth on host surface
PHIPO:0000349.definition: A pathogen colonization of host phenotype where the vegetative growth or proliferation of the pathogen on the host surface is present.
synonyms: pathogen growth present on host surface

PHIPO:0000350.label: absence of pathogen growth on host surface
PHIPO:0000350.definition: A pathogen colonization of host phenotype where the vegetative growth or proliferation of the pathogen on the host surface is absent.
synonyms: pathogen growth absent on host surface

PHIPO:0000352.label: normal formation of pathogen penetration structure prior to entry into host
PHIPO:0000352.definition: A pathogen growth with host phenotype in which the formation of the pathogen penetration structure is normal (i.e indistinguishable from wild type).
synonyms: normal formation of pathogen infection structure prior to entry into host
normal pre penetration of host by pathogen

PHIPO:0000363.label: absence of pathogen growth within host
PHIPO:0000363.definition: A pathogen host phenotype in which the vegetative growth or proliferation of the pathogen inside the host is absent.

PHIPO:0000432.label: catalytic activity phenotype
PHIPO:0000432.definition: A single organism phenotype that affects a catalytic activity.

PHIPO:0000442.label: normal pathogen asexual reproduction within host
PHIPO:0000442.definition: A pathogen reproductive phenotype within host where the pathogen asexual reproduction process, in which new individuals are produced by either a single cell or a group of cells, in the absence of any sexual process is normal (indistinguishable from wild type)(GO:0019954).

PHIPO:0000443.label: normal pathogen sexual reproduction within host
PHIPO:0000443.definition: A pathogen reproductive phenotype within host where the pathogen sexual reproduction process, in which new individuals are produced by combining the genetic material of two gametes, which may come from two organisms or from a single organism is normal (indistinguishable from wild type) (GO:0019953).

PHIPO:0000446.label: host cell death phenotype
PHIPO:0000446.definition: A single species phenotype that affects the cell death within a host.

PHIPO:0000461.label: presence of pathogen-associated host defense induced lesions
PHIPO:0000461.definition: A phenotype where the process of host tissue cell death causing a host lesion is induced by the host activating its own programmed cell death pathways in defense, is present.
synonyms: host programmed cell death phenotype induced by pathogen presence

PHIPO:0001264.label: host physiological process affected by pathogen phenotype
PHIPO:0001264.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, in which a pathogen effects a change in the physiological processes of its host organism.

UBERON:0001062.label: anatomical entity
UBERON:0001062.definition: Biological entity that is either an individual member of a biological species or constitutes the structural organization of an individual member of a biological species.

GO:0050789.label: regulation of biological process
GO:0050789.definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a biological process. Biological processes are regulated by many means; examples include the control of gene expression, protein modification or interaction with a protein or substrate molecule.

GO:0044419.label: biological process involved in interspecies interaction between organisms
GO:0044419.definition: Any process evolved to enable an interaction with an organism of a different species.

PATO:0001241.label: physical object quality
PATO:0001241.definition: A quality which inheres in a continuant.
synonyms: multiply inhering quality of a physical entity
quality of a single physical entity

PHIPO:0000246.label: abolished pathogen protein localization within host
PHIPO:0000246.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype in which the localization of a pathogen protein to a host structure or compartment is abolished (i.e. the protein was localized to the host structure or compartment and now is not).

PHIPO:0000430.label: carbohydrate binding phenotype
PHIPO:0000430.definition: A single species molecular function phenotype that affects carbohydrate binding. The affected gene product may be encoded by the mutated gene, or by a different gene.

PHIPO:0000472.label: normal pathogen asexual sporulation within host
PHIPO:0000472.definition: A pathogen reproductive phenotype within host where the process of pathogen asexual sporulation, the formation of spores derived from the products of an asexual cell division, is normal (GO:0030436).

PHIPO:0001045.label: decreased level of pathogen produced toxin within host
PHIPO:0001045.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype, in which the level of pathogen produced toxin usually present during infection is lower than normal.

PHIPO:0001106.label: presence of pathogen host protein-protein interaction
PHIPO:0001106.definition: A molecular function phenotype in which the binding of one pathogen protein to one host protein is present.
synonyms: binding present between pathogen protein and host protein

PHIPO:0001253.label: host immune system inflammatory response activated by pathogen present
PHIPO:0001253.definition: A pathogen host interaction phenotype where the host immune system inflammatory response during pathogen infection is present. (GO:0006954 inflammatory response).

PATO:0000033.label: concentration of
PATO:0000033.definition: A quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the amount of the bearer's there is mixed with another substance.

FOODON:00001015.label: plant food product
FOODON:00001015.definition: A food product which has as a defining ingredient some plant material.

ENVO:01001436.label: planned environmental usage process
ENVO:01001436.definition: A planned process during which humans access and obtain resources, benefits, or services from a natural or anthropised ecosystem.

ENVO:00001998.label: soil
ENVO:00001998.definition: An environmental material which is primarily composed of minerals, varying proportions of sand, silt, and clay, organic material such as humus, interstitial gases, liquids, and a broad range of resident micro- and macroorganisms.

CHEBI:50906.label: role
CHEBI:50906.definition: A role is particular behaviour which a material entity may exhibit.

ENVO:02500000.label: environmental system process
ENVO:02500000.definition: A process in which includes the components of an environmental system as participants.

ENVO:01000254.label: environmental system
ENVO:01000254.definition: A system which has the disposition to environ one or more material entities.

OBI:0000011.label: obsolete planned process
OBI:0000011.definition: A process that realizes a plan which is the concretization of a plan specification.

FOODON:03420116.label: organism material
FOODON:03420116.definition: Material which is distinguished primarily by the organism(s) it derives from.

BFO:0000040.label: material entity
BFO:0000040.definition: An independent continuant that is spatially extended whose identity is independent of that of other entities and can be maintained through time.

FOODON:00001261.definition: A plant food product which derives from one or more vegetables.

PATO:0000001.definition: A dependent entity that inheres in a bearer by virtue of how the bearer is related to other entities

ENVO:00010483.label: environmental material
ENVO:00010483.definition: A material entity which other material entities in an environmental system are primarily or partially composed of.

PATO:0001018.definition: A quality of a physical entity that exists through action of continuants at the physical level of organisation in relation to other entities.

ENVO:01000813.label: astronomical body part
ENVO:01000813.definition: A material part of an astronomical body.

FOODON:00004331.label: plant material
FOODON:00004331.definition: Anatomical or other piece(s) or substance derived from one or more plants.

FOODON:03315102.label: chicken egg material
FOODON:03315102.definition: Food material derived from a chicken egg.

GO:0008150.label: biological_process
GO:0008150.definition: A biological process is the execution of a genetically-encoded biological module or program. It consists of all the steps required to achieve the specific biological objective of the module. A biological process is accomplished by a particular set of molecular functions carried out by specific gene products (or macromolecular complexes), often in a highly regulated manner and in a particular temporal sequence.

PATO:0001241.definition: A quality which inheres in a continuant.

ENVO:01001483.label: surface of an astronomical body
ENVO:01001483.definition: A surface layer where the solid or liquid material of an astronomical body comes into contact with an atmosphere or outer space.

ENVO:00003082.label: enriched soil
ENVO:00003082.definition: A portion of enriched soil is a portion of soil with elevated levels of some material entity.

ENVO:03400017.label: depth of water ice
ENVO:03400017.definition: The depth of some water ice.

FOODON:00001057.label: plant fruit food product
FOODON:00001057.definition: A food product derived from plant fruit.

FOODON:00001256.label: dairy food product
FOODON:00001256.definition: A dairy food product has mammilian milk or a milk component as an ingredient.

ENVO:00002006.label: liquid water
ENVO:00002006.definition: An environmental material primarily composed of dihydrogen oxide in its liquid form.

FOODON:00001635.label: bean food product
FOODON:00001635.definition: A bean vegetable food product is a human or animal food product - such as a snap, shell or dry bean product - derived from the fruit pod, seed, or leaf of one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae.

BFO:0000004.label: independent continuant
BFO:0000004.definition: b is an independent continuant = Def. b is a continuant which is such that there is no c and no t such that b s-depends_on c at t. (axiom label in BFO2 Reference: [017-002])

FOODON:00001092.label: vertebrate food product
FOODON:00001092.definition: A food product which is derived from or produced by an animal that has a vertibrae.

FOODON:00005502.label: vertebrate material
FOODON:00005502.definition: Material which derives from one or more vertebrate animals.

BFO:0000002.definition: An entity that exists in full at any time in which it exists at all, persists through time while maintaining its identity and has no temporal parts.

BFO:0000003.label: occurrent
BFO:0000003.definition: An entity that has temporal parts and that happens, unfolds or develops through time.

BFO:0000017.label: realizable entity
BFO:0000017.definition: A specifically dependent continuant  that inheres in continuant  entities and are not exhibited in full at every time in which it inheres in an entity or group of entities. The exhibition or actualization of a realizable entity is a particular manifestation, functioning or process that occurs under certain circumstances.

CHEBI:24432.label: biological role
CHEBI:24432.definition: A role played by the molecular entity or part thereof within a biological context.

CHEBI:33232.label: application
CHEBI:33232.definition: Intended use of the molecular entity or part thereof by humans.

CHEBI:51086.label: chemical role
CHEBI:51086.definition: A role played by the molecular entity or part thereof within a chemical context.

ENVO:01001168.label: ecosystem fragmentation process
ENVO:01001168.definition: A process during which one or more parts of an ecosystem become causally isolated such that the direct flow or exchange of materials, resources, and energy between a given fragment and the remainder of the original system is severely curtailed or entirely halted.

FOODON:00004242.label: animal food product
FOODON:00004242.definition: A food product that is derived from some animal.

FOODON:00005501.label: mammal material
FOODON:00005501.definition: Material which derives from one or more mammals.

PATO:0000051.definition: A quality of a single physical entity inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's size or shape or structure.

CHEBI:78295.definition: A physiological role played by any substance that is distributed in foodstuffs. It includes materials derived from plants or animals, such as vitamins or minerals, as well as environmental contaminants.

FOODON:00004509.label: milled food product
FOODON:00004509.definition: A food product made from milling plant material.

PATO:0001236.label: process quality
PATO:0001236.definition: A quality which inheres in an process.

ENVO:00003074.label: manufactured product
ENVO:00003074.definition: A material entity that has been processed by humans or their technology in any way, including intermediate products as well as final products.

FOODON:00002403.label: food material
FOODON:00002403.definition: Any substance that can be consumed by an organism to satisfy nutritional or other health needs, or to provide a social or organoleptic food experience

ENVO:01001303.label: environmental role
ENVO:01001303.definition: A role which is may be realised by an environmental system

ENVO:08000001.definition: An environment that is determined by an axilla skin.

ENVO:08000002.label: mouth environment
ENVO:08000002.definition: An environment that is determined by a mouth.

FOODON:00001275.label: chicken egg food product
FOODON:00001275.definition: An avian egg food product having chicken eggs or derivatives as a defining ingredient.

ENVO:01000997.label: environmental system determined by a quality
ENVO:01000997.definition: An environmental system which is determined by materials bearing roughly homogeneous qualities.

ENVO:02500031.label: hydrological process
ENVO:02500031.definition: An environmental process which has water - in any of its states - as a participant.

ENVO:03000010.label: material transport process
ENVO:03000010.definition: A process during which material is displaced from its original location and transported either to a new location or back to the original location.

ENVO:3100036.label: concentration of chlorophyll in liquid water
ENVO:3100036.definition: The concentration of chlorophyll when measured in liquid water.

FOODON:00001013.label: cheese food product
FOODON:00001013.definition: Cheese is a food derived from milk that is produced in a wide range of flavors, textures, and forms by coagulation of the milk protein casein.

FOODON:00001264.label: legume food product
FOODON:00001264.definition: A one-celled fruit (pod) usually dehiscing down both sutures, and having the seed attached along a ventral suture. (Roubik 1995)

FOODON:02020050.label: avian material
FOODON:02020050.definition: Material that derives from some avian animal.

PATO:0000070.label: amount
PATO:0000070.definition: The number of entities of this type that are part of the whole organism.

UBERON:0001062.label: anatomical entity
UBERON:0001062.definition: Biological entity that is either an individual member of a biological species or constitutes the structural organization of an individual member of a biological species.

ENVO:01000313.label: anthropogenic environment
ENVO:01000313.definition: An anthropogenic environment is an environmental system which is the product of human activity.

ENVO:01000814.label: solid environmental material
ENVO:01000814.definition: An environmental material which is in a solid state.

PO:0009011.label: plant structure
PO:0009011.definition: A plant anatomical entity (PO:0025131) that is, or was, part of a plant, or was derived from a part of a plant.

ENVO:01003001.label: water-holding capacity
ENVO:01003001.definition: A disposition of a material entity which is realised when it is saturated with liquid water.

ENVO:02000007.label: tissue culture
ENVO:02000007.definition: Tissue culture is the culture of cells, tissues or organs in a nutrient medium under sterile conditions.

FOODON:00001262.label: botanical fruit food product
FOODON:00001262.definition: Mature ovary of a plant, with a fleshy part of the carpel that develops with the seed to attract animals for aid in dispersal. Botanically, nuts are considered fruits.

FOODON:03411283.label: melon plant
FOODON:03411283.definition: Melon is a name given to various members of the plant family *Cucurbitaceae* with sweet flavored, fleshy fruit e.g. gourds or cucurbits. Melon can be referred as a plant or a fruit. Many different cultivars have been produced, particularly of muskmelons.

FOODON:03414459.label: cucumis species
FOODON:03414459.definition: Cucumis is a genus of twining, tendril-bearing plants in the *Cucurbitaceae* family which includes the cucumber (*Cucumis sativus*), muskmelons (*Cucumis melo*, including cantaloupe and honeydew), the horned melon (*Cucumis metuliferus*), and the West Indian gherkin (*Cucumis anguria*). [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cucumis]

PATO:0103000.label: quantitative
PATO:0103000.definition: A quality of an entity that can be represented numerically, including anything that can be counted, measured, or given a numerical value.

PO:0009012.label: plant structure development stage
PO:0009012.definition: A stage in the life of a plant structure (PO:0009011) during which the plant structure undergoes developmental processes.
synonyms: etapa de desarrollo de estructura vegetal (Spanish, exact)

ENVO:01000281.label: layer
ENVO:01000281.definition: A material entity which 1) is spatially continuous, 2) is composed of material of comparable thickness, composition, and physical properties, and 3) is physically distinct from adjacent portions of environmental material.

ENVO:3200071.label: concentration of organic molecular entity in soil
ENVO:3200071.definition: The concentration of organic molecular entity when measured in soil.

PO:0025161.label: portion of plant substance
PO:0025161.definition: A portion of organism substance that is or was part of a plant.
synonyms: 植物を構成する物質の一部 (Japanese, exact)

ENVO:02500036.label: environmental pollution
ENVO:02500036.definition: An environmental system process that results in the introduction of contaminants into an environment.

ENVO:09000004.label: amount of carbon atom in environmental material
ENVO:09000004.definition: The amount of a carbon atom when measured in environmental material.

ENVO:09000013.label: amount of nitrogen atom in environmental material
ENVO:09000013.definition: The amount of a nitrogen atom when measured in environmental material.

FOODON:00001006.label: mammalian meat food product
FOODON:00001006.definition: A food product made of meat, the skeletal muscle and associated fat, and other edible tissues such as organs, livers, skin, brains, bone marrow, kidneys, or lungs, of mammals.

FOODON:00001242.label: spice or herb
FOODON:00001242.definition: A food product that has some spice or herb as a defining ingredient.

FOODON:00003341.label: brassica food product
FOODON:00003341.definition: A genus of plants in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). The members of the genus are informally known as cruciferous vegetables, cabbages, or mustard plants.

PO:0025131.label: plant anatomical entity
PO:0025131.definition: An anatomical entity that is or was part of a plant.
synonyms: 植物 解剖学（形態）的実体 (Japanese, exact)

ENVO:2100000.label: anatomical entity environment
ENVO:2100000.definition: An environment which is determined by an anatomical entity.

NCIT:C20189.label: Property or Attribute
NCIT:C20189.definition: A distinguishing quality or prominent aspect of a person, object, action, process, or substance.

SO:0000001.label: region
SO:0000001.definition: A sequence_feature with an extent greater than zero. A nucleotide region is composed of bases and a polypeptide region is composed of amino acids.

NCIT:C19157.label: Specimen
NCIT:C19157.definition: A part of a thing, or of several things, taken to demonstrate or to determine the character of the whole, e.g. a substance, or portion of material obtained for use in testing, examination, or study; particularly, a preparation of tissue or bodily fluid taken for examination or diagnosis.

IAO:0000030.label: information entity
IAO:0000030.definition: An information entity is an entity that represents information about some other entity.  For example, a measurement, a clustered data set.

OBI:0000011.label: planned process
OBI:0000011.definition: A processual entity that realizes a plan which is the concretization of a plan specification.

OBI:0000070.definition: A planned process that has the objective to produce information about a material entity (the evaluant) by examining it.

NCIT:C26548.definition: A protein, RNA or a complex that contains proteins and/or RNA.

NCIT:C70699.label: Biospecimen
NCIT:C70699.definition: Any material sample taken from a biological entity for testing, diagnostic, propagation, treatment or research purposes, including a sample obtained from a living organism or taken from the biological object after halting of all its life functions. Biospecimen can contain one or more components including but not limited to cellular molecules, cells, tissues, organs, body fluids, embryos, and body excretory products.

HANCESTRO:0290.label: genetically isolated population
HANCESTRO:0290.definition: A population with increased genetic homogeneity and reduced genetic variation due to cultural or geographic isolation

FOODON:03470107.label: food preservation process
FOODON:03470107.definition: The methods contributing to the prevention or retardation of microbial, enzymatic or oxidative spoilage and thus to the extension of shelf life. Index all methods for which information is available, even if a corresponding descriptor has already been used in *H. TREATMENT APPLIED*. Preservation descriptors refer to the finished food as a whole with these exceptions: (1) if the components of a multi-component food, such as cream pie, are preservation by different methods, index all methods; (2)  if chemical preservatives are declared on the label, always index them even if it is known that the preservative was introduced through or is only present in a component or ingredient of the food; and (3) if the preservation method for an ingredient is declared on the label (such as brie cheese made from pasteurized milk) index it. Also use *INGREDIENT preservation by THERMAL PROCESSING* or *INGREDIENT preservation by IRRADIATION* when ingredients have been pasteurized, ultrapasteurized, sterilized or irradiated.

FOODON:00003368.label: food contact material
