OBI:0000659.label: specimen collection process
OBI:0000659.definition: A planned process with the objective to obtain a material entity for potential use as an input upon which measurements or observations are performed.

FOODON:03530108.label: food facility preparation process
FOODON:03530108.definition: The process of producing and/or retailing post-harvest food in a consumer or industrial context.

OBI:0000245.label: organization
OBI:0000245.definition: An entity that can bear roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules. Members of organizations are either organizations themselves or individual people. Members can bear specific organization member roles that are determined in the organization rules. The organization rules also determine how decisions are made on behalf of the organization by the organization members.

FOODON:03500051.label: food contact surface from human-made material

BFO:0000019.label: quality
BFO:0000019.definition: A quality is an attribute that is intrinsically associated with its bearer (or its parts), but whose presence/absence and observed/measured value may vary.

BFO:0000031.label: generically dependent continuant
BFO:0000031.definition: b is a generically dependent continuant = Def. b is a continuant that g-depends_on one or more other entities. (axiom label in BFO2 Reference: [074-001])

SO:0001410.label: experimental_feature
SO:0001410.definition: A region which is the result of some arbitrary experimental procedure. The procedure may be carried out with biological material or inside a computer.

FOODON:03450037.label: food reheating
FOODON:03450037.definition: A process to bring an already fully cooked product to serving temperature.

FOODON:03530152.label: agricultural food production
FOODON:03530152.definition: A food production process involving the rearing of an organism.

IAO:0000033.label: directive information entity
IAO:0000033.definition: An information content entity whose concretizations indicate to their bearer how to realize them in a process.

OBI:0001933.label: value specification
OBI:0001933.definition: An information content entity that specifies a value within a classification scheme or on a quantitative scale.

BFO:0000023.label: role
BFO:0000023.definition: A role is an entity which is borne in a material entity in some kinds of natural, social or institutional contexts, but which is not essential to the fundamental definition of that material entity (i.e. the material entity exists with or without the role).  For example, the role of a person as a surgeon, the role of an artificial heart in pumping blood, the role of a chemical compound in an experiment, the role of a drug in the treatment of a disease.

FOODON:03510136.label: food consumer group
FOODON:03510136.definition: A food consumer group is a class of organism based on their heterotrophic requirements or preferences.

FOODON:03530206.label: food production
FOODON:03530206.definition: A planned process involving the rearing, manufacture or distribution of food material.

GO:0008150.label: biological_process
GO:0008150.definition: Any process specifically pertinent to the functioning of integrated living units: cells, tissues, organs, and organisms. A process is a collection of molecular events with a defined beginning and end.

OBI:0100051.label: specimen
OBI:0100051.definition: A material entity that is collected for potential use as an input upon which measurements or observations are performed.

TRANS:0000000.label: transmission process
TRANS:0000000.definition: A process that is the means during which the pathogen is transmitted directly or indirectly from its natural reservoir, a susceptible host or source to a new host.

GENEPIO:0001681.label: laboratory sequencing datum
GENEPIO:0001681.definition: A datum related to the sequencing assay process applied to an isolate.

OBI:0001882.label: target material in specimen specification
OBI:0001882.definition: A plan specification which specifies the type of material that will be assayed in an investigation.

NCIT:C87913.label: Microbiology Specimen Origin
NCIT:C87913.definition: A site where a microbiology specimen is collected.

FOODON:03500050.label: food contact surface from natural material

GENEPIO:0002018.label: personal health datum
GENEPIO:0002018.definition: A personal health datum is a datum that pertains to the health situation or history of an individual.

IAO:0000577.label: centrally registered identifier symbol
IAO:0000577.definition: A symbol that is part of a CRID and that is sufficient to look up a record from the CRID's registry.

GENEPIO:0100631.label: identifier field
GENEPIO:0100631.definition: A data field which describes a symbol that is part of a centrally registered identifier database (CRID) and that is sufficient to look up a record from the CRID's registry.

FOODON:00002470.label: food material characteristic
FOODON:00002470.definition: A physical object quality which describes a characteristic of some food material.

FOODON:03510026.label: human as food consumer
FOODON:03510026.definition: Food produced and marketed for human use.

GENEPIO:0001171.label: organism role
GENEPIO:0001171.definition: A role which inheres in an organism and is realized by the process of being alive.

GENEPIO:0001237.label: specimen source material category
GENEPIO:0001237.definition: The type of material from which the specimen was obtained. Specimens are usually categorized as food, body products or tissues, or environmental material.

OBI:0600005.label: collecting specimen from organism
OBI:0600005.definition: a process with the objective to obtain a material entity that was part of an organism for potential future use in an investigation

IAO:0000104.label: plan specification
IAO:0000104.definition: A directive information entity with action specifications and objective specifications as parts, and that may be concretized as a realizable entity that, if realized, is realized in a process in which the bearer tries to achieve the objectives by taking the actions specified.

OBI:0000973.label: sequence data
OBI:0000973.definition: A measurement datum that representing the primary structure of a macromolecule(it's sequence) sometimes associated with an indicator of confidence of that measurement.

GENEPIO:0000106.label: draft data standard
GENEPIO:0000106.definition: The 'draft data standard' class contains draft representations of formal or defacto third party standards and related components.  These representations may have been crafted without any involvement of related standards issuers and so no guarantee can be provided about their currency, accuracy or veracity.

GENEPIO:0000134.label: specimen source substance
GENEPIO:0000134.definition: A specimen source substance is an organism substance or food product or environmental substance from which the specimen was extracted.

GENEPIO:0001048.label: infectious disease exposure event
GENEPIO:0001048.definition: An event where one or more hosts are exposed to an infectious pathogen

GENEPIO:0001275.label: human to human exposure process
GENEPIO:0001275.definition: A process in which one or more humans may be exposed to one or more contagious human infectious disease carriers.

PATO:0000001.label: quality
PATO:0000001.definition: A dependent entity that inheres in a bearer by virtue of how the bearer is related to other entities

SO:0001248.label: assembly
SO:0001248.definition: A region of the genome of known length that is composed by ordering and aligning two or more different regions.

UBERON:0001062.label: anatomical entity
UBERON:0001062.definition: Biological entity that is either an individual member of a biological species or constitutes the structural organization of an individual member of a biological species.

GENEPIO:0002162.label: specimen collection site specification
GENEPIO:0002162.definition: A specification for a geographic location that a specimen was collected at.

OBI:0000658.label: data representational model
OBI:0000658.definition: An information content entity representing the relationships between data items.

BFO:0000016.label: disposition
BFO:0000016.definition: A disposition is an entity that causes a specific process or transformation in an entity in which it inheres, under specific circumstances and in conjunction with the laws of nature. For example, the disposition of vegetables to decay when not refrigerated, the disposition of blood to coagulate, the disposition of a patient with a weakened immune system to contract disease.

FOODON:03490100.label: food packaging
FOODON:03490100.definition: A food contact material which encloses the food and can be in the type of a container, packaging or wrapping.

FOODON:03500010.label: food product contact surface
FOODON:03500010.definition: The specific container or coating materials in direct contact with the food. [FDA CFSAN 1995]

IAO:0000300.label: textual entity
IAO:0000300.definition: A textual entity is a part of a manifestation (FRBR sense), a generically dependent continuant whose concretizations are patterns of glyphs intended to be interpreted as words, formulas, etc.

OBI:0100026.label: organism
OBI:0100026.definition: A material entity that is an individual living system, such as animal, plant, bacteria or virus, that is capable of replicating or reproducing, growth and maintenance in the right environment. An organism may be unicellular or made up, like humans, of many billions of cells divided into specialized tissues and organs.

OBI:0600047.label: sequencing assay
OBI:0600047.definition: An assay the uses chemical or biochemical means to infer the sequence of a biomaterial

OMIT:0001005.label: Analytical,Diagnostic and Therapeutic Techniques and Equipment Category

PATO:0001241.label: physical object quality
PATO:0001241.definition: A quality which inheres in a continuant.
synonyms: multiply inhering quality of a physical entity
quality of a single physical entity

GENEPIO:0002167.label: specimen collection site
GENEPIO:0002167.definition: The physical location that a specimen was collected at.  The location may be described by geographic coordinates, city or other geopolitical entity, biome, etc.

NCIT:C165587.label: Pooled Sample
NCIT:C165587.definition: A sample containing a mixture of multiple individual specimens of interest that were collected in a study.

GENEPIO:0001741.label: draft GenEpiO component record
GENEPIO:0001741.definition: This class contains components under development for fulfilling GenEpiO and other standard data specifications. Components are relevant to epidemiological, laboratory, clinical or environmental pathogen sample data collection and analysis.

FOODON:00002403.label: food material
FOODON:00002403.definition: Any substance that can be consumed by an organism to satisfy nutritional or other health needs, or to provide a social or organoleptic food experience

FOODON:03470120.label: heat treatment food preservation
FOODON:03470120.definition: Preservation by the use of high temperature for a time sufficient to reduce or destroy undesirable microorganisms and enzyme activity. [FDA CFSAN 1995]

OMP:0000000.label: microbial phenotype
OMP:0000000.definition: The observable manifestation of the genotype of a microbial cell or group of cells in an environment.

OMP:0000274.label: antimicrobial agent resistance phenotype
OMP:0000274.definition: A microbial phenotype related to the resistance or sensitivity of a microbe to antimicrobial agents that kill (microbiocidal) or inhibit growth (microbiostatic) of a microbe.

OMP:0007167.label: population growth phenotype
OMP:0007167.definition: A microbial phenotype relating to the growth of a microbial population, i.e. an increase in the size of the population resulting from reproduction of individual microbes in the population.

GO:0008150.label: biological_process
GO:0008150.definition: Any process specifically pertinent to the functioning of integrated living units: cells, tissues, organs, and organisms. A process is a collection of molecular events with a defined beginning and end.

OMP:0000197.label: microbe-host interaction phenotype
OMP:0000197.definition: A microbial phenotype related to the interactions between a microbe and its host(s).

OMP:0007568.label: resistance to stress phenotype
OMP:0007568.definition: A population growth phenotype related to the resistance or sensitivity that microbes in a population show when exposed to a stress. Typically, a population is deemed resistant to a stress if microbes in the population continue to grow and multiply when exposed to the stress. A population is deemed sensitive to a stress if microbes in the population stop growing and multiplying (and may die) when exposed to the stress.

OMP:0007001.label: altered motility
OMP:0007001.definition: A motility phenotype where the frequency, rate, timing, or extent of a microbe's motility is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007085.label: altered microbial phenotype
OMP:0007085.definition: A microbial phenotype that is altered in some way relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007103.label: altered cell morphology
OMP:0007103.definition: A cell morphology phenotype where the morphology (i.e., size, shape, and structure) of a cell is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007195.label: chemical resistance phenotype
OMP:0007195.definition: A biological process phenotype related to the resistance or sensitivity of a microbe to a chemical entity.

OMP:0000176.label: biofilm formation phenotype
OMP:0000176.definition: A multi-organism phenotype dealing with the process in which microorganisms attach to and grow on a surface and produce extracellular polymers that facilitate attachment and matrix formation.

OMP:0007194.label: biological process phenotype
OMP:0007194.definition: A microbial phenotype that affects a biological process.

OMP:0007252.label: colonization of a host phenotype
OMP:0007252.definition: A microbe-host interaction phenotype that relates to the ability of a microbe to colonize a host organism.

OMP:0000071.label: cell morphology phenotype
OMP:0000071.definition: A microbial phenotype related to the form and structure of a microbial cell.

OMP:0007794.label: cell population growth phenotype
OMP:0007794.definition: A cell population phenotype that affects the rate or extent of growth of a population of microbial cells.

GO:0048870.label: cell motility
GO:0048870.definition: Any process involved in the controlled self-propelled movement of a cell that results in translocation of the cell from one place to another.

PATO:0000001.label: quality
PATO:0000001.definition: A dependent entity that inheres in a bearer by virtue of how the bearer is related to other entities

OMP:0007192.label: effect of non-nutrient environmental factors on population growth phenotype
OMP:0007192.definition: A population growth phenotype related to how non-nutrient environmental factors affect growth of a microbial population.

OMP:0000068.label: virulence phenotype
OMP:0000068.definition: A microbe-host interaction phenotype related to the ability of a microbe to cause disease in another organism (the host).

OMP:0007006.label: population phenotype
OMP:0007006.definition: A microbial phenotype where the phenotype is observed at the level of a microbial population.

OMP:0007197.label: cellular component phenotype
OMP:0007197.definition: A microbial phenotype that affects a quality of a cellular component.

OMP:0007403.label: altered microbe-host interaction
OMP:0007403.definition: A microbe-host interaction phenotype where the frequency, rate, timing, or extent of interaction is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007541.label: virion morphology phenotype
OMP:0007541.definition: A virus phenotype related to the form and structure of a virion.

OMP:0000133.label: absence of motility
OMP:0000133.definition: A motility phenotype where a microbe lacks the ability to perform controlled self-propelled movement that results in translocation of the cell from one place to another.

OMP:0007157.label: altered population growth
OMP:0007157.definition: A population growth phenotype where the rate and/or extent of growth of a microbial population is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007264.label: drug-dependent population growth phenotype
OMP:0007264.definition: A population growth phenotype related to whether reproduction of an organism is dependent on the presence of a drug in the growth medium.

OMP:0007633.label: cellular physical quality phenotype
OMP:0007633.definition: A cell phenotype that affects any physical object quality of a microbial cell, such as morphology, number, location, etc., of a cell or a cellular component.

OMP:0007134.label: altered resistance to an antimicrobial agent
OMP:0007134.definition: An antimicrobial agent resistance phenotype where resistance or sensitivity to an antimicrobial agent is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0000026.label: host-virus interaction phenotype
OMP:0000026.definition: A microbial phenotype related to the ability of a host to be infected by and/or support reproduction of a virus.

OMP:0007555.label: multicellular microorganism morphology phenotype
OMP:0007555.definition: A microbial phenotype relating to the size, shape, or appearance of a multicellular microorganism.

OMP:0000005.label: presence of motility
OMP:0000005.definition: A motility phenotype where a microbe possesses the ability to perform controlled self-propelled movement that results in translocation from one place to another.

OMP:0005243.label: filamentous growth phenotype
OMP:0005243.definition: An organismal growth phenotype relating to the process by which a multicellular organism, a unicellular organism, or a group of unicellular organisms grow in a threadlike, filamentous shape.

OMP:0007332.label: cellular process phenotype
OMP:0007332.definition: A biological process phenotype that affects a cellular process, which is any biological process that is carried out at the cellular level, but not necessarily restricted to a single cell.

OMP:0007684.label: cell growth phenotype
OMP:0007684.definition: A growth phenotype related to cell growth, which is the process in which a cell irreversibly increases in size over time by accretion and biosynthetic production of matter similar to that already present.

GO:0040011.label: locomotion
GO:0040011.definition: Self-propelled movement of a cell or organism from one location to another.

OMP:0000001.label: motility phenotype
OMP:0000001.definition: A locomotion phenotype where the trait in question is the self-propelled movement of a microbe from one location to another.

OMP:0000174.label: growth phenotype
OMP:0000174.definition: A microbial phenotype related to the increase in size or mass over time of an entire organism, a part of an organism, or a cell.

OMP:0005111.label: resistance to killing by host phenotype
OMP:0005111.definition: A microbe-host interaction phenotype relating to the resistance or sensitivity of a microbe to killing by a host.

OMP:0005129.label: altered biofilm formation
OMP:0005129.definition: A biofilm formation phenotype where the occurrence, extent, or timing of biofilm formation is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007044.label: growth factor requirement phenotype
OMP:0007044.definition: A nutrient utilization phenotype related to whether an organism requires an essential organic compound (growth factor) for growth and reproduction.

OMP:0007315.label: population morphology phenotype
OMP:0007315.definition: A microbial phenotype related to the appearance of a microbial population, such as a colony, liquid culture, or biofilm.

OMP:0007556.label: hyphal morphology phenotype
OMP:0007556.definition: A multicellular microorganism morphology phenotype relating to the size, shape, or appearance of a hypha, which is a branching filamentous structure that consists of one or more cells surrounded by a tubular cell wall.

PATO:0001241.label: physical object quality
PATO:0001241.definition: A quality which inheres in a continuant.
synonyms: multiply inhering quality of a physical entity
quality of a single physical entity

OMP:0000173.label: response to stress phenotype
OMP:0000173.definition: A biological process phenotype related to a change in state or activity of a microbe (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a disturbance in organismal or cellular homeostasis, usually, but not necessarily, exogenous (e.g. temperature, humidity, ionizing radiation).

OMP:0005281.label: colonization of host tissue phenotype
OMP:0005281.definition: A colonization of a host phenotype relating to the ability of a microbe to colonize a host tissue.

OMP:0007255.label: altered colonization of a host
OMP:0007255.definition: A colonization of a host phenotype where the frequency, rate, timing, or extent of colonization is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007774.label: population growth on defined medium phenotype
OMP:0007774.definition: A population growth phenotype relating to the growth of a microbial population in the vegetative phase of the life cycle to reproduce on a defined medium.

OMP:0007783.label: cellular process phenotype during vegetative growth
OMP:0007783.definition: A phenotype that affects a cellular process in the vegetative phase of the life cycle.
synonyms: cellular process phenotype during vegetative growth

OMP:0005116.label: multi-organism process phenotype
OMP:0005116.definition: A microbial phenotype related to a biological process that involves two or more organisms of the same or different species.

OMP:0006022.label: nutrient utilization phenotype
OMP:0006022.definition: A microbial phenotype that affects the utilization of a nutrient, which is a substance used for biosynthesis or energy release and capture.

OMP:0007130.label: differential test phenotype
OMP:0007130.definition: A microbial phenotype related to the presence or absence of a biochemical activity in a test used to differentiate and identify microorganisms.

OMP:0007161.label: regulation phenotype
OMP:0007161.definition: A microbial phenotype that affects the regulation of a molecular function, biological process, or biological quality.

OMP:0007540.label: virus phenotype
OMP:0007540.definition: A microbial phenotype related to the form and structure of a virus.

OMP:0007632.label: cell phenotype
OMP:0007632.definition: A microbial phenotype that is observed at the level of an individual cell.

OMP:0005002.label: temperature effects on population growth phenotype
OMP:0005002.definition: A population growth range phenotype related to how growth of a microbial population is affected by the temperature of the environment.

OMP:0005008.label: pH effects on population growth phenotype
OMP:0005008.definition: A population growth phenotype relating to how the rate and/or extent of growth of a microbial population is affected by the pH of the environment.

OMP:0007576.label: resistance to radiation stress phenotype
OMP:0007576.definition: A resistance to stress phenotype related to the resistance or sensitivity that microbes in a population show when exposed to radiation.

OMP:0008000.label: spore morphology phenotype
OMP:0008000.definition: A microbial phenotype that is related to the form and structure of a spore or spores produced by a microbe.

OMP:0000098.label: altered virulence
OMP:0000098.definition: A virulence phenotype where the rate, frequency, time, or extent of the ability of a microbe to cause disease in another organism (host) is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0005141.label: altered resistance to killing by host
OMP:0005141.definition: A resistance to killing by host phenotype where the resistance or sensitivity of a microbe to killing by a host cells is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0005206.label: adhesion to host phenotype
OMP:0005206.definition: An adhesion phenotype that relates to the ability of a microbe to attach to a host via adhesion molecules, general stickiness, etc., either directly or indirectly. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic relationship.

OMP:0005209.label: altered adhesion to host
OMP:0005209.definition: An adhesion to host phenotype where the frequency, rate, timing, or extent of attachment of a microbe to a host is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0005323.label: altered cell motility by swarming
OMP:0005323.definition: A cell motility by swarming phenotype where the frequency, rate, timing, or extent of swarming is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0005324.label: altered cell motility by swimming
OMP:0005324.definition: A cell motility by swimming phenotype where the frequency, rate, timing, or extent of swimming is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007079.label: altered growth factor requirement
OMP:0007079.definition: A growth factor requirement phenotype where an organism's requirement for a growth factor for growth and reproduction is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007237.label: bacteriophage sensitivity phenotype
OMP:0007237.definition: A host-virus interaction phenotype related to whether a bacterium can be infected by and/or support growth of a bacteriophage.

OMP:0007394.label: lethality phenotype
OMP:0007394.definition: A microbe-host interaction phenotype related to the ability of a microbe to infect and cause death of a host.

OMP:0007470.label: altered population morphology
OMP:0007470.definition: A population morphology phenotype where the visible appearance of a microbial population is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007492.label: altered motility by gliding
OMP:0007492.definition: A motility by gliding phenotype where the frequency, rate, timing, or extent of gliding is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007493.label: altered cell motility by twitching
OMP:0007493.definition: A cell motility by twitching phenotype where the frequency, rate, timing, or extent of twitching is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007698.label: cell population phenotype
OMP:0007698.definition: A population phenotype that is observed at the level of a population of microbial cells.

OMP:0007748.label: cellular physical quality phenotype during vegetative growth
OMP:0007748.definition: A phenotype related to any physical object quality, such as morphology, number, location, etc., of a microbial cell or a cellular component in the vegetative growth phase of the life cycle.

OMP:0007931.label: altered population phenotype
OMP:0007931.definition: A microbial population phenotype where the phenotype of a microbial population is altered in some way relative to a designated control.

PATO:0000069.label: deviation(from_normal)
PATO:0000069.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the whether the bearer differs from normal or average.

GO:0008152.label: metabolic process
GO:0008152.definition: The chemical reactions and pathways, including anabolism and catabolism, by which living organisms transform chemical substances. Metabolic processes typically transform small molecules, but also include macromolecular processes such as DNA repair and replication, and protein synthesis and degradation.
synonyms: metabolic process resulting in cell growth

GO:0009987.label: cellular process
GO:0009987.definition: Any process that is carried out at the cellular level, but not necessarily restricted to a single cell. For example, cell communication occurs among more than one cell, but occurs at the cellular level.

GO:0040007.label: growth
GO:0040007.definition: The increase in size or mass of an entire organism, a part of an organism or a cell.

OMP:0000039.label: O2 effects on population growth phenotype
OMP:0000039.definition: A population growth range phenotype related to how growth of a microbial population is affected by different concentrations of oxygen gas (O2) in the environment.

OMP:0005013.label: solute and water activity effects on population growth phenotype
OMP:0005013.definition: A population growth range phenotype related to how growth of a microbial population is affected by  the concentration of solutes (water activity) in the environment.

OMP:0005288.label: colonization of tissue in an immunocompromised host phenotype
OMP:0005288.definition: A colonization of a host phenotype that deals with the ability of a microbe to colonize tissue of an immunocompromised host.

OMP:0007115.label: altered population growth rate
OMP:0007115.definition: A population growth phenotype where the rate at which a population of microbes multiplies is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007248.label: altered resistance to chemical
OMP:0007248.definition: A chemical resistance phenotype where resistance or sensitivity of a microbe to a chemical is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007578.label: resistance to cold shock phenotype
OMP:0007578.definition: A resistance to stress phenotype related to the resistance or sensitivity of a microbial population to cold shock. Cold shock is a form of temperature stress in which cells are briefly exposed to a low temperature, usually below the lowest growth temperature of the microbe.

OMP:0007579.label: resistance to heat shock phenotype
OMP:0007579.definition: A resistance to stress phenotype related to the resistance or sensitivity of a microbial population to heat shock. Heat shock is a form of temperature stress in which cells are briefly exposed to a high temperature, usually above the highest growth temperature of the microbe.

OMP:0007657.label: level of cellular reactive oxygen species phenotype
OMP:0007657.definition: A cell phenotype relating to the amount of reactive oxygen species (ROS) measured in a cell.

OMP:0007691.label: vegetative cell growth phenotype
OMP:0007691.definition: A cell growth phenotype related to the growth of a cell in the vegetative growth phase of the life cycle. Cell growth is the process in which a cell irreversibly increases in size over time by accretion and biosynthetic production of matter similar to that already present.

OMP:0007809.label: altered cell population growth
OMP:0007809.definition: A cell population growth phenotype where the rate or extent of growth of a population of microbial cells is altered relative to a designated control.

OMP:0007811.label: cellular pigment accumulation phenotype
OMP:0007811.definition: A cellular process phenotype that affects the occurrence of pigment accumulation in a microbial cell.

OMP:0007932.label: resistance to nutrient limitation stress phenotype
OMP:0007932.definition: A resistance to stress phenotype related to the resistance or sensitivity of a microbial population to limitation for an essential nutrient.

OMP:0007964.label: cell population growth during nutrient limitation phenotype
OMP:0007964.definition: A cell population growth phenotype related to the rate or extent of growth of a microbial population under conditions of limitation for an essential nutrient (i.e. conditions where an essential nutrient is present at low concentration).

GO:0001539.label: cilium or flagellum-dependent cell motility
GO:0001539.definition: Cell motility due to movement of eukaryotic cilia or bacterial-type flagella or archaeal-type flagella.

GO:0042330.label: taxis
GO:0042330.definition: The directed movement of a motile cell or organism in response to an external stimulus.
synonyms: directed movement in response to stimulus

OMP:0000065.label: absence of virulence
OMP:0000065.definition: A virulence phenotype where an organism does not possess the ability to cause disease in another organism (host).

OMP:0000100.label: colony morphology phenotype
OMP:0000100.definition: A multicellular phenotype dealing with the physical characteristics of an assemblage of microorganisms growing on a solid surface such as the surface of an agar culture medium.

OMP:0005237.label: golgi apparatus phenotype
OMP:0005237.definition: A cellular component phenotype relating to the golgi apparatus, which is the endomembranous cytoplasmic eukaryotic organelle involved in secretion and intracellular transport.

OMP:0005238.label: golgi apparatus morphology phenotype
OMP:0005238.definition: A golgi apparatus phenotype that relates to the size, shape, or appearance of the Golgi apparatus or its parts. The golgi apparatus usually appears as flattened ribosome-free vesicles arranged in a more or less regular stack.

OMP:0005269.label: endomembrane system phenotype
OMP:0005269.definition: A cellular component phenotype relating to the endomembrane, a collection of membranous structures involved in transport within the cell. The endomembrane system includes the nuclear envelope, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, vacuoles, vesicles, and the plasma membrane. Members of the endomembrane system pass materials through each other or through the use of vesicles.

OMP:0005270.label: endomembrane system morphology phenotype
OMP:0005270.definition: An endomembrane system phenotype that relates to the form and structure of components of the endomembrane system.

OMP:0007104.label: altered nutrient utilization
OMP:0007104.definition: A nutrient utilization phenotype that is altered relative to a designated control.
